notes: Three waws stand in the verse and the ASV writes three connectives, so the italicized *And* was aligned to the waw of וַתֹּאמַר rather than marked added; marking it added and s012 unrepresented was the competing reading, and the italic corroborates neither side decisively (rules 14, 42 and 7).
פָּנֶיהָ is not reached by any English verb once הֵעֵזָה is recast as the attributive *impudent*, so the supplied *with* is the nominal's under rule 33 rather than a verb's under rule 44.
The Hebrew gloss *She hardened her face, and said* corroborates the recasting and decides nothing (rule 38).
